title: Updating langevin to work with QM/MM and RATTLE constraints (from @asod)
body:
This merge request obsotes  ase/ase!197 and  ase/ase!252 .  It is a rebased version of the latter.

It is a reimplementation of Langevin dynamics based on work by Elvar and Asmus (@asod).  
Implements Langevin dynamics as described in http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.cplett.2006.07.086
author: schiotz

comments.author: jensj
